optimization_notes: SQL calls SP 4 times (modes 1,2,3,4). PySpark: Run 1 = modes 1+2+3 combined (shared pipeline, branched output). Run 2 = mode 4 only (704c-specific).

sections.name: Init & Config
sections.description: Variable declarations, config lookups (LineTypeID, AllocationTypeID, GlobalMenu settings, etc.)

sections.name: Load Allocation Input
sections.description: Mode-dependent input: Mode 2/PE+1/4 → AllocationInput; Mode 3 → SM_LookThroughAllocationInput. Early return if empty.

sections.name: Temp Table Creation
sections.description: Create ~40 temp tables (FinalCostPercentage, CostPercentageMinQuarter, etc.). In PySpark these become schemas/empty DataFrames or are eliminated via fusion.

sections.name: Entity Hierarchy & Underlyings
sections.description: Build entity hierarchy, underlying types, asset class relationships, lookthrough input. Key: udfGetAssetClassRelationship TVF inlining.

sections.name: Cost Percentage Snapshot & UNPIVOT
sections.description: Load CostPercentage via udfGetCostPercentageDetails TVF. Mode!=4: normal cost %. Mode=4: AllocationPercentage704c UNPIVOT. 704c mapping logic. Mode 1 + 704c: complex DAR setup.

sections.name: Underlyings Combined & Asset Class
sections.description: Build #TempAllUnderlyingsCombined with ordering, asset class filtering, ignore-partnership-level config.

sections.name: Book Effective & Custom Allocation Rules
sections.description: Load BookEffective_Snapshot, apply custom allocation rules (CAR). Mode 1/4: K1 line processing. Build #TempAllUnderlyings with ROW_NUMBER pickup order.

sections.name: Input Lines & Amount-Based Allocation
sections.description: Build #TempInputLines from lookthrough input. Amount-based allocation logic (delete AMOUNT rows, compute FinalAmounts).

sections.name: Non-Dated & Dated Entities
sections.description: Split entities into non-dated and dated categories based on IsTransactionDate/IsTransfersAdjusted.

sections.name: PFIC Footnote Lines
sections.description: PFIC footnote processing. Custom footnotes. Build #TempAllUnderlyingsFNOrdered. Complex footnote-to-K1 mapping. Part V quarters. Mode-dependent processing.

sections.name: State Allocation (Mode 3)
sections.description: State-specific: SM_StateLineAllocationRule, state input loading, state non-dated/dated entities.

sections.name: Cost Percentage Load by Underlying Type
sections.description: Load cost percentages for: Underlying Only, Entity Total, Asset Class. Handle TrackingKey/Tag matching. Transfer adjustments.

sections.name: Missing Entities & Min Quarter
sections.description: Find entities without percentages, determine minimum quarter, handle 100% validation, AllocationRunErrors.

sections.name: Effective Percentage Calculation
sections.description: Core cost percentage and transfer-affected cost percentage calculation. Non-dated effective percentages.

sections.name: Dated Pickup Order & Transfer Logic
sections.description: Dated entities pickup order, missing partner insertion for transfer-adjusted percentages, yearly.

sections.name: Non-Dated PFIC/K1 Percentage Load
sections.description: Load non-dated PFIC and K1 line percentages. Transfer-affected and yearly.

sections.name: Plugging Logic
sections.description: Ensure percentages sum to 100% per group. Find max commitment partner, plug the difference. Update TypeID for non-cost types using cost %.

sections.name: Return Data
sections.description: Mode-dependent final SELECT. Modes 1,2,3 return different column sets. Mode 4: only 704c rows.
